'''''The Secrets of Jedi Power''''' was a document that could be purchased from the [[Galactic Archives]] in [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri's]] [[Trader's Plaza]]. It was recently added to the store's catalog around the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] and was considered a bestseller. It claimed to answer all the questions about the galaxy's mystical practitioners. To access the document, an interested purchaser would have blue tabs attached to their [[credit tab]] and would need to travel to their central archives location some distance away. Then the purchaser would be faced with either a high price for the document, around two thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], or haggle down to something more reasonable, pending they brought along a friend the next time.

When a curious [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] attempted to access the document, he was able to haggle the price down to nine hundred credits for the file and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].
